records.source: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִקְצֵ֣ה צָפ֡וֹנָה אֶל־יַ֣ד דֶּֽרֶךְ־חֶתְלֹ֣ן׀לְֽבוֹא־חֲמָ֡ת חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָן֩ גְּב֨וּל דַּמֶּ֤שֶׂק צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ אֶל־יַ֣ד חֲמָ֔ת וְהָיוּ־ל֧וֹ פְאַת־קָדִ֛ים הַיָּ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And these [are] [the] names of the tribes: from [the] end northward, beside [the] way of Hethlon, Lebo-hamath, Hazar-enan, [the] border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath, and they will be his, [the] side east [to] the west: Dan, one.
pieces: These are the names of the tribes and their portions. At the northern end, along the Hethlon road to Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enan on the Damascus border, with Hamath lying to the north, reaching from the east side to the west, Dan is to have one portion.

L.1: And these [are] the names of the tribes: from the northern end, beside the Hethlon road to Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enan, at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath, and [the portion] will extend from the east side to the west: Dan, one [portion].

R.1: Here are the names of the tribes and the land each will receive. The share of Dan will be at the far north. Its northern edge will follow the northern border of the land, along the Hethlon road to Lebo-hamath and on to Hazar-enan, with Damascus and Hamath to the north. It will reach from the eastern border to the western border.

decisions.choice: the tribes in bands across the land: a new allotment
decisions.reason: Each tribe receives a strip of land running the full width of the country from east to west, all of equal width (47:14). Seven tribes lie north of the holy portion and five south of it. The order is not that of Joshua: the tribes descended from Jacob's servant wives, Bilhah and Zilpah (Dan, Naphtali, Asher, Gad), lie farthest from the sanctuary, and Judah and Benjamin lie nearest it, on either side (verses 7, 23).

decisions.choice: and they will be his, the east side to the west: the portion runs from the eastern to the western border
decisions.reason: The words are compressed. "His" refers to each tribe's portion. The Hebrew reads "the east side the west"; the sense, as in verses 2-8, is from the east side to the west side.

decisions.choice: one [portion] (L); one portion (B); share (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "Dan, one"; the word "portion" is supplied from verse 8 and 47:13.

records.heading: The portions of the tribes

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל דָּ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה אָשֵׁ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Dan, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Asher, one.
pieces: Asher is to have one portion, bordering Dan from the east side to the west side.

L.2: And beside Dan's border, from the east side to the west side: Asher, one [portion].

R.2: Asher's share will be next to Dan's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל אָשֵׁ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה נַפְתָּלִ֥י אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Asher, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Naphtali, one.
pieces: Naphtali is to have one portion, bordering Asher from the east side to the west side.

L.3: And beside Asher's border, from the east side to the west side: Naphtali, one [portion].

R.3: Naphtali's share will be next to Asher's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל נַפְתָּלִ֗י מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Naphtali, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Manasseh, one.
pieces: Manasseh is to have one portion, bordering Naphtali from the east side to the west side.

L.4: And beside Naphtali's border, from the east side to the west side: Manasseh, one [portion].

R.4: Manasseh's share will be next to Naphtali's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Manasseh, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Ephraim, one.
pieces: Ephraim is to have one portion, bordering Manasseh from the east side to the west side.

L.5: And beside Manasseh's border, from the east side to the west side: Ephraim, one [portion].

R.5: Ephraim's share will be next to Manasseh's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל אֶפְרַ֗יִם מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה רְאוּבֵ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Ephraim, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Reuben, one.
pieces: Reuben is to have one portion, bordering Ephraim from the east side to the west side.

L.6: And beside Ephraim's border, from the east side to the west side: Reuben, one [portion].

R.6: Reuben's share will be next to Ephraim's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל רְאוּבֵ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה יְהוּדָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Reuben, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Judah, one.
pieces: Judah is to have one portion, bordering Reuben from the east side to the west side.

L.7: And beside Reuben's border, from the east side to the west side: Judah, one [portion].

R.7: Judah's share will be next to Reuben's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֖ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֑מָּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר־תָּרִ֡ימוּ חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֹ֗חַב וְאֹ֜רֶךְ כְּאַחַ֤ד הַחֲלָקִים֙ מִפְּאַ֤ת קָדִ֨ימָה֙ עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Judah, from [the] side east to [the] side westward, will be the contribution which you will set apart, twenty-five thousand breadth, and length like one of the portions, from [the] side east to [the] side westward; and the sanctuary will be in its midst.
pieces: Next to Judah's territory, from the east side to the west side, will be the special portion you are to set apart. It is to be {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} wide, and as long as one of the tribal portions from the east side to the west, with the sanctuary in the middle of it.

L.8: And beside Judah's border, from the eastern side to the western side, will be the contribution that you set apart, 25,000 [cubits] wide, and in length like one of the [tribal] portions, from the eastern side to the western side; and the sanctuary will be in the middle of it.

R.8: Next to Judah's land, from east to west, will be the special area you must set aside. It will be {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} wide from north to south. From east to west it will be as long as the tribes' shares. The temple will be in the middle of it.

decisions.choice: the contribution: the holy portion of 45:1-8
decisions.reason: The special portion of land set apart for the LORD, the priests, the Levites, the city and the prince is described again here, in more detail (verses 8-22). See 45:1.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary in the middle: the LORD's house at the center of the land
decisions.reason: The sanctuary stands at the center of the people's land, with the tribes around it, as the tabernacle stood in the middle of Israel's camp (Numbers 2:2, 17).

decisions.choice: contribution (L); special portion (B); special area (R)
decisions.reason: As in 45:1.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Worked on the long cubit; the unit is supplied, as in 45:1.

records.source: הַתְּרוּמָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּרִ֖ימוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃
records.gloss: The contribution which you will set apart to Yahweh: length twenty-five thousand and breadth ten thousand.
pieces: The special portion that you are to set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is to be {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long and {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} wide.

L.9: The contribution that you will set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [will be] 25,000 [cubits] long and 10,000 wide.

R.9: The special area that you set aside for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long and {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} wide.

decisions.choice: 10,000 wide: the Septuagint reads "20,000"
decisions.reason: As in 45:1, the Septuagint has 20,000, the width of the priests' and Levites' strips together. Here the Hebrew 10,000 again gives the priests' strip. The translation keeps the Hebrew.

records.source: וּ֠לְאֵ֜לֶּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה תְרֽוּמַת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ֮ לַכֹּֽהֲנִים֒ צָפ֜וֹנָה חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֗לֶף וְיָ֨מָּה֙ רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְקָדִ֗ימָה רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְנֶ֕גְבָּה אֹ֕רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וְהָיָ֥ה מִקְדַּשׁ־יְהוָ֖ה בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: And to these will be the holy contribution, to the priests: northward twenty-five thousand, and westward breadth ten thousand, and eastward breadth ten thousand, and southward length twenty-five thousand; and the sanctuary of Yahweh will be in its midst.
pieces: This holy portion is to belong to the priests. It is to measure {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} on the north side, {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} on the west side, {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} on the east side and {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} on the south side. The sanctuary of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is to be in the middle of it.

L.10: And this will be the holy contribution for the priests: on the north 25,000 [cubits long], on the west 10,000 wide, on the east 10,000 wide, and on the south 25,000 long; and the sanctuary of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be in the middle of it.

R.10: This holy area will belong to the priests. It will measure {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} on the north and south sides and {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} on the east and west sides. The temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be in the middle of it.

decisions.choice: the holy contribution (L); holy portion (B); holy area (R)
decisions.reason: As in 45:6.

records.source: לַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽמְקֻדָּשׁ֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י צָד֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תָע֗וּ בִּתְעוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ס
records.gloss: For the priests, the one consecrated, of [the] sons of Zadok, who kept my charge, who did not go astray when [the] sons of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray,
pieces: It is for the consecrated priests, the descendants of Zadok, who carried out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} service. They did not stray when the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} strayed, as the Levites did.

L.11: [It will be] for the consecrated priests, of the sons of Zadok, who kept {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} charge, who did not go astray when the sons of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

R.11: It is for the priests who have been set apart as holy, the descendants of Zadok. They served {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} faithfully. They did not turn away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} when the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} turned away, as the Levites did.

decisions.choice: the sons of Zadok, who did not go astray: as 44:15
decisions.reason: The verse restates the reason given in 44:10-16 for the honor of the Zadokite priests.

decisions.choice: the one consecrated: a singular form
decisions.reason: The word "consecrated" is singular in the Hebrew, perhaps referring to the priesthood as a whole. The ancient versions read the plural.

decisions.choice: sons of Zadok (L); descendants of Zadok (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 40:46.

records.source: וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם תְּרוּמִיָּ֛ה מִתְּרוּמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־גְּב֖וּל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
records.gloss: And it will be to them a special contribution from [the] contribution of the land, most holy, at [the] border of the Levites.
pieces: It will be a special gift to them from the special portion of the land, a most holy area next to the territory of the Levites.

L.12: And it will be to them a special portion from the contribution of the land, a most holy [place], bordering the territory of the Levites.

R.12: This most holy land will be the priests' own share of the special area. It will be next to the land of the Levites.

decisions.choice: a special contribution: a rare form of the word *terumah*
decisions.reason: The form is found only here. It seems to mean a portion taken out of the larger portion: the priests' strip within the whole special area.

records.heading: The Levites, the city and the prince

records.source: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם לְעֻמַּת֙ גְּב֣וּל הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים כָּל־אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃
records.gloss: And the Levites, alongside [the] border of the priests, twenty-five thousand length and breadth ten thousand; all [the] length twenty-five thousand and breadth ten thousand.
pieces: Alongside the priests' territory the Levites are to have an area {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long and {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} wide. The whole length is to be {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} and the width {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}}.

L.13: And alongside the territory of the priests the Levites [will have an area] 25,000 [cubits] long and 10,000 wide; the whole length [will be] 25,000 and the width 10,000.

R.13: Next to the priests' land, the Levites will have an area {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long and {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} wide.

decisions.choice: the whole length 25,000 and the width 10,000: the Septuagint reads "20,000" for the width
decisions.reason: The repeated measure may sum up the priests' and Levites' areas together; the Septuagint reads "20,000" for this width. The translation keeps the Hebrew.

records.source: וְלֹא־יִמְכְּר֣וּ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹ֥א יָמֵ֛ר וְלֹ֥א יַעֲבִ֖יר רֵאשִׁ֣ית הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
records.gloss: And they will not sell any of it, and they will not exchange, and they will not transfer [the] first of the land, for [it is] holy to Yahweh.
pieces: They must not sell any of it or exchange it, and this best part of the land must not pass to anyone else, for it is holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

L.14: And they will not sell any of it, nor exchange [it], nor transfer this choicest part of the land, for [it is] holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

R.14: They must not sell any of this land or trade it. This best part of the land must never be given to anyone else, because it belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and is holy.

decisions.choice: not to be sold: holy land cannot be traded away
decisions.reason: The law forbade selling the pasturelands of the Levites' towns (Leviticus 25:34) and exchanging what was holy (Leviticus 27:10, 28, 33).

decisions.choice: transfer: the written text and the reading tradition differ
decisions.reason: The written text has "it will pass over", the reading tradition "they will cause to pass over". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the first of the land: the best part, like firstfruits
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for firstfruits (44:30). The holy portion is the land's "firstfruits", given to the LORD.

records.source: וַחֲמֵ֨שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֜ים הַנּוֹתָ֣ר בָּרֹ֗חַב עַל־פְּנֵ֨י חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף חֹֽל־ה֣וּא לָעִ֔יר לְמוֹשָׁ֖ב וּלְמִגְרָ֑שׁ וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָעִ֖יר בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: And the five thousand remaining in breadth, in front of the twenty-five thousand, [is] common [land] for the city, for dwelling and for open land; and the city will be in its midst.
pieces: The remaining area, {{units:about 1 2/3 miles|5,000 cubits}} wide and {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long, is to be for the ordinary use of the city, for houses and for open land. The city is to be in the middle of it.

L.15: And the 5,000 [cubits] that remain in width, alongside the 25,000, [will be] for common use for the city, for dwellings and for open land; and the city will be in the middle of it.

R.15: The rest of the area, {{units:about 1 2/3 miles|5,000 cubits}} wide and {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long, will not be holy. It will be used by the city for homes and open land. The city will be in the middle of it.

decisions.choice: common: for ordinary, not holy, use
decisions.reason: The word is the one set against "holy" in 22:26, 42:20 and 44:23. The city's land is not part of the holy area but is still part of the LORD's portion.

decisions.choice: open land: as in 45:2
decisions.reason: The open land around the city, for pasture and to keep it apart.

decisions.choice: open land (all levels)
decisions.reason: As in 45:2.

records.source: וְאֵלֶּה֮ מִדּוֹתֶיהָ֒ פְּאַ֣ת צָפ֗וֹן חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־נֶ֕גֶב חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּמִפְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ים חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־יָ֕מָּה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִֽים׃
records.gloss: And these [will be] its measurements: [the] north side four thousand five hundred, and [the] south side four thousand five hundred, and from [the] east side four thousand five hundred, and [the] west side four thousand five hundred.
pieces: These are to be its measurements: the north side {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}}, the south side {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}}, the east side {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} and the west side {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}}.

L.16: And these [will be] its measurements: the north side 4,500 [cubits], the south side 4,500, the east side 4,500, and the west side 4,500.

R.16: The city will be a square. Each of its four sides will be {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long.

decisions.choice: four equal sides: the city is a square
decisions.reason: Like the temple area (42:20) and the whole holy portion (verse 20), the city is a square. Revelation 21:16 measures the holy city as a square, equal in length and width.

decisions.choice: the south side: one word is written twice in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: The word for "five" in the south side's measure is written twice, a copying slip that the scribes marked to be left unread.

decisions.choice: each of its four sides (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the four equal measures once.

records.source: וְהָיָ֣ה מִגְרָשׁ֮ לָעִיר֒ צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְנֶ֖גְבָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וְקָדִ֨ימָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְיָ֖מָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
records.gloss: And there will be open land for the city: northward two hundred fifty, and southward two hundred fifty, and eastward two hundred fifty, and westward two hundred fifty.
pieces: The city's open land is to be {{units:about 440 feet|250 cubits}} wide on the north, {{units:about 440 feet|250 cubits}} on the south, {{units:about 440 feet|250 cubits}} on the east and {{units:about 440 feet|250 cubits}} on the west.

L.17: And the city will have open land: on the north 250 [cubits], on the south 250, on the east 250, and on the west 250.

R.17: There will be open land around the city, {{units:about 440 feet|250 cubits}} wide on every side.

decisions.choice: open land around the city: as for the Levites' towns
decisions.reason: The Levites' towns had open land around them for their flocks (Numbers 35:2-5).

decisions.choice: on every side (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the four equal measures once.

records.source: וְהַנּוֹתָ֨ר בָּאֹ֜רֶךְ לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים קָדִ֨ימָה֙ וַעֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֕ה לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהָיְתָ֤ה תְבֽוּאָתוֹ֙ לְלֶ֔חֶם לְעֹבְדֵ֖י הָעִֽיר׃
records.gloss: And the remainder in length alongside [the] holy contribution, ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward, will be alongside the holy contribution; and its produce will be for food for [the] workers of the city.
pieces: The rest of the length alongside the holy portion, {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} on the east and {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} on the west, will run alongside the holy portion. Its crops are to be food for the workers of the city.

L.18: And the rest of the length, alongside the holy contribution, [will be] 10,000 [cubits] to the east and 10,000 to the west; it will be alongside the holy contribution, and its produce will be food for the workers of the city.

R.18: On each side of the city, east and west, there will be land {{units:about 3 1/3 miles|10,000 cubits}} long next to the holy area. The crops grown there will feed the people who work in the city.

decisions.choice: food for the workers of the city: farmland to support the city
decisions.reason: The land on either side of the city is farmland. Its produce supports those who work in the city (verse 19).

records.source: וְהָעֹבֵ֖ד הָעִ֑יר יַעַבְד֕וּהוּ מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
records.gloss: And the one who works the city, they will work it from all [the] tribes of Israel.
pieces: The workers of the city, who will come from all the tribes of Israel, are to farm it.

L.19: And the workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, will work it.

R.19: People from all the tribes of Israel will work in the city and farm this land.

decisions.choice: from all the tribes of Israel: the city belongs to the whole people
decisions.reason: As in 45:6, the city is not the property of one tribe; people from every tribe live and work there.

decisions.choice: the one who works the city ... will work it: a hard construction
decisions.reason: The words may mean that the city's workers farm the land of verse 18, or simply that they serve the city. The pronoun "it" may refer to either.

records.source: כָּל־הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף רְבִיעִ֗ית תָּרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֖ת הָעִֽיר׃
records.gloss: All the contribution [is] twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand; square you will set apart the holy contribution together with [the] holding of the city.
pieces: The whole special portion is to be a square, {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} on each side. You are to set apart the holy portion together with the city's property.

L.20: The whole contribution [will be] 25,000 [cubits] by 25,000; you will set apart the holy contribution as a square, together with the holding of the city.

R.20: The whole special area, including the holy area and the city's land, will be a square. Each side will be {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} long.

decisions.choice: square: literally "fourth"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means "four-sided" or "square".

decisions.choice: a square of 25,000: the holy portion at the center of the land
decisions.reason: The priests' strip, the Levites' strip and the city's strip together make a square 25,000 cubits on each side (10,000 + 10,000 + 5,000).

records.source: וְהַנּוֹתָ֣ר לַנָּשִׂ֣יא מִזֶּ֣ה׀וּמִזֶּ֣ה׀לִתְרֽוּמַת־הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֪ת הָעִ֟יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֥לֶף׀תְּרוּמָה֮ עַד־גְּב֣וּל קָדִימָה֒ וְיָ֗מָּה עַל־פְּ֠נֵי חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ עַל־גְּב֣וּל יָ֔מָּה לְעֻמַּ֥ת חֲלָקִ֖ים לַנָּשִׂ֑יא וְהָֽיְתָה֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ הַבַּ֖יִת בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: And the remainder [is] for the prince, on this [side] and on this of the holy contribution and of the holding of the city, in front of [the] twenty-five thousand of [the] contribution to [the] east border, and westward in front of [the] twenty-five thousand to [the] west border, alongside the portions [is] for the prince; and the holy contribution and the sanctuary of the house will be in its midst.
pieces: What is left on both sides of the holy portion and the city's property is to belong to the prince. It will reach east from the {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} of the special portion to the eastern border, and west from the {{units:about 8 1/4 miles|25,000 cubits}} to the western border, alongside the tribal portions. This will belong to the prince. The holy portion, with the sanctuary of the temple, will be in the middle of it.

L.21: And what remains [will be] for the prince, on both sides of the holy contribution and the city's holding, from the 25,000 of the contribution eastward to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 to the western border, alongside the [tribal] portions; [it will be] for the prince. And the holy contribution and the sanctuary of the house will be in the middle of it.

R.21: The land that is left on both sides of the holy area and the city's land will belong to the ruler. It will reach east to the eastern border and west to the western border, alongside the tribes' shares. The holy area, with the temple in it, will be between the ruler's two pieces of land.

decisions.choice: the prince's land: as in 45:7
decisions.reason: See 45:7-8. The prince's land lies on either side of the central square, east and west, and divides the tribes' lands no further.

decisions.choice: prince (L, B); ruler (R)
decisions.reason: As in 44:3.

records.source: וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֤ת הַלְוִיִּם֙ וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר בְּת֛וֹךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִֽהְיֶ֑ה בֵּ֣ין׀גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבֵין֙ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִהְיֶֽה׃
records.gloss: And from [the] holding of the Levites and from [the] holding of the city, in [the] midst of what belongs to the prince; between [the] border of Judah and [the] border of Benjamin, it will be for the prince.
pieces: The property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the middle of the prince's land. The land between the territory of Judah and the territory of Benjamin is to belong to the prince.

L.22: And [apart] from the holding of the Levites and the holding of the city, which are in the middle of what belongs to the prince, [the area] between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin will belong to the prince.

R.22: The land of the Levites and the land of the city will be in the middle of the ruler's land. Everything else between Judah's land and Benjamin's land will belong to the ruler.

decisions.choice: from the holding of the Levites and of the city: excluding them
decisions.reason: The verse is compressed. It seems to say that, apart from the Levites' land and the city's land, all the land between Judah and Benjamin on either side belongs to the prince.

records.source: וְיֶ֖תֶר הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה בִּנְיָמִ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And the rest of the tribes: from [the] side east to [the] side westward, Benjamin, one.
pieces: As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin is to have one portion, from the east side to the west side.

L.23: And the rest of the tribes: from the eastern side to the western side, Benjamin, one [portion].

R.23: Here are the shares of the other tribes. Benjamin's share will reach from the east to the west.

decisions.choice: Benjamin: south of the holy portion
decisions.reason: In Joshua's allotment Benjamin lay north of Judah, with Jerusalem on the border between them (Joshua 18:16). Here the order is reversed, and Judah and Benjamin lie on either side of the holy portion.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה שִׁמְע֥וֹן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Benjamin, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Simeon, one.
pieces: Simeon is to have one portion, bordering Benjamin from the east side to the west side.

L.24: And beside Benjamin's border, from the east side to the west side: Simeon, one [portion].

R.24: Simeon's share will be next to Benjamin's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל שִׁמְע֗וֹן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה יִשָׂשכָ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Simeon, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Issachar, one.
pieces: Issachar is to have one portion, bordering Simeon from the east side to the west side.

L.25: And beside Simeon's border, from the east side to the west side: Issachar, one [portion].

R.25: Issachar's share will be next to Simeon's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל יִשָׂשכָ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה זְבוּלֻ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Issachar, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Zebulun, one.
pieces: Zebulun is to have one portion, bordering Issachar from the east side to the west side.

L.26: And beside Issachar's border, from the east side to the west side: Zebulun, one [portion].

R.26: Zebulun's share will be next to Issachar's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַ֣ל׀גְּב֣וּל זְבוּלֻ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה גָּ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Zebulun, from [the] side eastward to [the] side westward: Gad, one.
pieces: Gad is to have one portion, bordering Zebulun from the east side to the west side.

L.27: And beside Zebulun's border, from the east side to the west side: Gad, one [portion].

R.27: Gad's share will be next to Zebulun's, reaching from the east to the west.

records.source: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל גָּ֔ד אֶל־פְּאַ֖ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִתָּמָ֗ר מֵ֚י מְרִיבַ֣ת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה עַל־הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
records.gloss: And at [the] border of Gad, to [the] south side southward, the border will be from Tamar [to] [the] waters of Meribath-kadesh, [to] [the] Wadi, to the Great Sea.
pieces: On the south side of Gad's territory, the border is to run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, along the Wadi of Egypt to the Great Sea.

L.28: And next to the border of Gad, on the south side, toward the south, the boundary will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, [along] the Wadi [of Egypt] to the Great Sea.

R.28: The southern border of Gad's land will be the southern border of the whole land. It will run from Tamar to the springs at Meribath-kadesh. Then it will follow the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.

decisions.choice: Tamar, Meribath-kadesh, the Wadi: the southern border of 47:19
decisions.reason: Gad's southern edge is the southern border of the land, described in 47:19.

decisions.choice: [of Egypt] (L); the Wadi of Egypt (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 47:19.

records.source: זֹ֥את הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּפִּ֥ילוּ מִֽנַּחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
records.gloss: This [is] the land which you will allot as inheritance to [the] tribes of Israel, and these [are] their portions, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.
pieces: This is the land you are to divide by lot as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

L.29: This [is] the land that you will allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these [are] their portions, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

R.29: This is the land you must divide among the tribes of Israel as their inheritance. These are their shares, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

records.source: וְאֵ֖לֶּה תּוֹצְאֹ֣ת הָעִ֑יר מִפְּאַ֣ת צָפ֔וֹן חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים מִדָּֽה׃
records.gloss: And these [are] [the] exits of the city: from [the] north side, four thousand five hundred [is the] measurement.
pieces: These are to be the exits of the city: On the north side, which is {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long,

L.30: And these [are] the exits of the city: on the north side, 4,500 [cubits] by measure,

R.30: These will be the gates of the city. On the north side, which will be {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long,

decisions.choice: exits: the ways out of the city, its gates
decisions.reason: The word means the places of going out; verses 31-34 name them as gates.

records.heading: The gates of the city

records.source: וְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֗יר עַל־שְׁמוֹת֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁעָרִ֥ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה שַׁ֣עַר רְאוּבֵ֞ן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יְהוּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר לֵוִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And [the] gates of the city [will be] according to [the] names of [the] tribes of Israel, gates three northward: [the] gate of Reuben one, [the] gate of Judah one, [the] gate of Levi one.
pieces: there will be three gates: one for Reuben, one for Judah and one for Levi. The gates of the city are to be named after the tribes of Israel.

L.31: (the gates of the city [will be named] after the names of the tribes of Israel) three gates on the north: Reuben's gate, one; Judah's gate, one; Levi's gate, one.

R.31: there will be three gates, named after Reuben, Judah and Levi. All the gates of the city will carry the names of the tribes of Israel.

decisions.choice: the gates named after the tribes: as in Revelation 21:12-13
decisions.reason: The holy city of Revelation 21:12-13 has twelve gates, three on each side, with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel written on them.

decisions.choice: the gate of Levi: Levi is counted here
decisions.reason: Levi has no tribal land (44:28), but has a gate in the city. To keep the number at twelve, Ephraim and Manasseh are counted as one gate, the gate of Joseph (verse 32).

decisions.choice: the naming of the gates after the list (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the list of the north gates first, then the rule for naming the gates.

records.source: וְאֶל־פְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ימָה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וְשַׁ֨עַר יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר דָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And to [the] east side four thousand five hundred, and gates three: and [the] gate of Joseph one, [the] gate of Benjamin one, [the] gate of Dan one.
pieces: On the east side, which is {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long, there will be three gates: one for Joseph, one for Benjamin and one for Dan.

L.32: And on the east side, 4,500 [cubits], three gates: Joseph's gate, one; Benjamin's gate, one; Dan's gate, one.

R.32: On the east side, which will be {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long, there will be three gates, named after Joseph, Benjamin and Dan.

records.source: וּפְאַת־נֶ֗גְבָּה חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֜וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מִדָּ֔ה וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר שִׁמְע֞וֹן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יִשָּׂשכָר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר זְבוּלֻ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And [the] south side, four thousand five hundred measurement, and gates three: [the] gate of Simeon one, [the] gate of Issachar one, [the] gate of Zebulun one.
pieces: On the south side, which measures {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}}, there will be three gates: one for Simeon, one for Issachar and one for Zebulun.

L.33: And on the south side, 4,500 [cubits] by measure, three gates: Simeon's gate, one; Issachar's gate, one; Zebulun's gate, one.

R.33: On the south side, which will be {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long, there will be three gates, named after Simeon, Issachar and Zebulun.

records.source: פְּאַת־יָ֗מָּה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים שַֽׁעֲרֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר גָּ֞ד אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר אָשֵׁר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר נַפְתָּלִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: [The] west side, four thousand five hundred; their gates three: [the] gate of Gad one, [the] gate of Asher one, [the] gate of Naphtali one.
pieces: On the west side, which is {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long, there will be three gates: one for Gad, one for Asher and one for Naphtali.

L.34: On the west side, 4,500 [cubits], their three gates: Gad's gate, one; Asher's gate, one; Naphtali's gate, one.

R.34: On the west side, which will be {{units:about 1 1/2 miles|4,500 cubits}} long, there will be three gates, named after Gad, Asher and Naphtali.

records.source: סָבִ֕יב שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וְשֵׁם־הָעִ֥יר מִיּ֖וֹם יְהוָ֥ה׀שָֽׁמָּה׃
records.gloss: Around, eighteen thousand. And [the] name of the city from [that] day: Yahweh [is] there.
pieces: The distance around the city will be {{units:about 6 miles|18,000 cubits}}. And from that day the name of the city will be {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is There.

L.35: The circumference [will be] 18,000 [cubits]. And the name of the city from [that] day [will be], {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [Is] There.

R.35: The wall around the city will be {{units:about 6 miles|18,000 cubits}} long. From that time on, the city will be called "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is There."

decisions.choice: the name of the city: The LORD Is There
decisions.reason: The book ends with the city's new name, *YHWH shammah*, "the LORD is there". It sums up the whole vision: the glory that left the temple (10:18-19; 11:22-23) has returned (43:1-7), and the LORD will dwell among his people for ever (37:27-28; 43:7). Jerusalem receives new names elsewhere in the prophets as well (Isaiah 60:14; 62:2-4; Jeremiah 3:17; 33:16). Revelation 21:3 and 22:3-4 describe the holy city in the same way: God himself will be with his people.

decisions.choice: from that day: from the day the city is built
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean "from that day on", from the time the city is founded, or "from now on".

decisions.choice: 18,000: the city's four sides of 4,500
decisions.reason: The four sides of 4,500 cubits (verses 30-34) make 18,000, about 6 miles around.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is There (L, B, R); the divine_name span
decisions.reason: The city's name contains the divine name, so it takes the divine_name setting: "Yahweh Is There" when the reader chooses the name. Literal brackets "Is", which the Hebrew leaves out; Balanced and Readable write the name in title form, and Readable puts it in quotation marks so that it is read as a name.
